newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble says U.K. approves Didronel.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble says U.K. approves Didronel.

text.p: Regulatory authorities in the United Kingdom have approved the use of a Procter & Gamble Co's Didronel PMO therapy for the prevention of osteoporosis in post-menopausal women, the company said on Wednesday.
Didronel PMO, which consists of etidronate disodium and calcium supplementation, was approved in 1992 in the United Kingdom for the treatment of established spinal osteoporosis.
Procter & Gamble said the treatment is the first non-hormonal therapy approved in the United Kingdom for osteoporosis prevention.
The approval also makes Didronel PMO the first and only treatment available in the United Kingdom for the prevention and treatment of corticosteroid-induced osteoporosis, the company said.
